items.evidence: The acceptance test passes and asserts the exact archives contents and bytes, the ::warning:: sha256-mismatch line, all four drop reasons, 'restored 1 of 5 .deb files (4 dropped)', the apt-cache calls 'show libbar=2:0.9' and 'show libfoo1:amd64=1.2-3', and the single 'sudo -n cp --' call. Judge holdout through the CLI with fake apt-cache/sudo, in a cache path containing a space: a one-byte-flipped file is dropped with the ::warning:: line; a record with the wrong arch or version is dropped as 'not in the apt index'; a non-zero apt-cache exit that still prints a matching record is dropped; a multi-record reply with an uppercase SHA and an epoch %3A name is accepted via the 'name=version' spec form; a leading-dash name and a newline name are rejected and the newline is logged as '?', so no injected '::error::' line appears; a directory with a .deb name is 'not a regular file'; copied bytes are identical and source files are left in place (A-4). All pass.

The acceptance test passes and asserts no sudo call and the 'apt-cache unavailable' drop, 'restored 0 of 0' for a missing --from, and exit 1 with '::error::...copying verified archives failed (exit code 1)'. Holdout: when every file is dropped, the run exits 0 and sudo is never called; with sudo absent from PATH it exits 1 with the ::error line; when sudo exits 3 it exits 1 with '(exit code 3)'. All pass.

The acceptance test passes and asserts the exact cache contents [libfoo1_1.2-3, libnew_4.0], the fresh bytes replacing a stale copy, '2 .deb files' and '(2 not used by this install)', and creation of a missing --to. Holdout: an installed package with a different arch or version, an iF status and a symlinked .deb are all not collected; an epoch archive matching dpkg '1:2.0' is collected; a planted .deb file and a .deb-named directory in the cache are removed while a non-.deb file is kept; the counts read '2 .deb files' and '(4 not used by this install)'; a missing --from with an empty dpkg reports 0 and creates --to. All pass.

The acceptance test passes and asserts exit 1 with '::error::apt-archives: dpkg-query failed (exit code 2)', and exit 2 with stderr starting 'apt-archives: usage:' for six bad invocations. Holdout: dpkg-query absent from PATH gives exit 1 with the ::error line; the cases prune, missing --to, missing --from, a stray positional, an unknown option and '--from' with no value all exit 2 with the usage prefix. All pass.

The unit test passes and asserts the exact parser outputs, including null for every bad name listed in the spec, lower-cased sha256, the skipped record without SHA256 and the rc/iU lines being skipped. Holdout via the exported functions: an uppercase %3A epoch decodes; null for an uppercase package name, a .DEB suffix, an empty version, an empty arch, '../' and a trailing newline; parseAptRecords skips the record without SHA256 and lower-cases the others; parseInstalled keeps only ii (rejects rc, iU and hi). All pass.

The wiring test passes and asserts the exact bodies of the Update, Restore, Collect and Save steps, Save at Collect+1, the full order, no if: lines on the five apt steps, no combined actions/cache for apt, the install bodies and timeout 20.
